parole.significato: to move [with مِنْ (min) ‘from inside’] (somewhere) to outside; to leave; to exit; to get out
parole.testo: From the root خ ر ج (ḵ r j), ultimately from Iranian; see خَرَاج (ḵarāj, “poll-tax”).

parole.significato: treasury, closet (room where valuables are stored)
parole.testo: The term must ultimately be declared to be from the same Iranian circle as كَنْز (kanz, “treasure”), from Old Median *ganǰam (“treasure, treasury”), but its form possibly a resultant noun to the verb خَزَنَ (ḵazana, “to treasure”).

parole.significato: to dig a trench, to make a trench
parole.testo: An Iranian borrowing: compare Persian کندک (kandak), کنده (kanda), Old Armenian քանդակ (kʻandak) (also from Iranian).

parole.significato: darbuka, a goblet drum of the Arab world and Turkey; in Iran, called a تمبک (tombak)

parole.significato: dates or in particular dates that are dry in such a manner that they dissolve well in the mouth
parole.testo: Unknown. Perhaps borrowed from Iranian. Compare Old Armenian ազոխ (azox, “unripe grapes”), Persian ازخ (azox, “rotten and empty nut”).
